description: The completed sales behind a price: date, price, grader and grade, platform, listing title. Up to 500 newest; filter by grade ("PSA 10", "RAW") and days.

card.description: PokeInvest card ID (pi_16322, from search_cards), the numeric ID in a PokeInvest card URL, or a card name such as "Umbreon Gold Star POP Series 5" (best match is used)

days.description: Only sales from the last N days, 1-1095; omit for all on file

grade.description: Only this grade, e.g. "PSA 10", "CGC 9.5", "BGS 9.5", or "RAW" for ungraded; omit for all

name: get_sales
